docs.title: ➗ CHAPTER 4: DIVISION
docs.text: "Flag Method = One-line mastery"

docs.title: FLAG METHOD VISUALS
docs.text:
848 ÷ 31 (Energy ÷ Days)
Divisor: 31 │ Flagpole: 3 │ Flag: 1

Step 1: 8÷3=2 Rem2→24
Step 2: 24-(1×2)=22 22÷3=7 Rem1→18
Step 3: 18-(1×7)=11 11÷3=3
Result: 27.3
848
───────
27.3

docs.title: HOW FLAG WORKS (2026 Quick Reference)
docs.text:
Step Action Formula 1 First digit ÷ flagpole 8÷3 = 2 (rem 2) 2 Bring down × flag subtract 24 - (1×2) = 22 3 Next digit ÷ flagpole 22÷3 = 7 (rem 1) 4 Repeat until done 18 - (1×7) = 11

🔥 PRO TIP: Flag = divisor's last digit. Flagpole = first digits.
